paragraphs.text:
“Yaaah!”  cries  Bernard.  The  beasts  drag  him  backward  and 
throw him to the ground. They pummel him with rough clubs 
and large stones. He is clearly doomed.

Sylvia seems about to go back to help. You and Norman pull 
her away. While the ape-men are occupied, you flee to safety in 
the meadowland below.

Heavyhearted over Bernard’s gruesome demise, you have a 
decision to make.

To explore the valley without Bernard, go to 551. To leave, go 
to 291.
